notes.title: Console versions and local multiplayer are here!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/7mXXV6n.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone!

We’re really happy to announce that we’ve launched Action Henk on the PlayStation 4 and the Xbox One. It’s taken us some time, but the wait was definitely worth it. The console version of Action Henk introduces a new local multiplayer feature, and because it’s a real blast, we’re also bringing the local multiplayer to the PC version! Time to invite some friends for some Henkin’!

With this patch we’ve also fixed some important bugs (which are listed below) and are bringing in a new skin for Kentony to get this party started! We’ve also noticed that we’ve gained a lot of Spanish and Portuguese friends, so we included these languages in the build as well: ‘Olá!’

If there is ever a question or anything you’d like to know, get in touch with us through the Action Henk community forum and we’ll be happy to help you out! 

Cheers!

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Local Multiplayer! Have fun racing your friends on the couch!
[*]The long-awaited Carnaval Kentony is now unlockable! Beat his special [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=635322454]Carnaval Kentony Festival[/url] level to unlock him!
[*]Spanish and Portuguese languages have been added.
[*]The cutscene exploit should be fixed now, we will be removing invalid scores on the leaderboard over the next couple of days.
[*]Fixed the level editor bug with environments not unlocking and levels switching to the basic environment.
[/list]

notes.title: Merry HENKmas
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/6v7dkwe.jpg[/img]

Yoooo everybody!

It’s Christmas time, so how about a little gift? We’re happy to introduce to you the all new Winter environment! In this environment we have a bunch of deleted scenes from back in early access, and added a couple of completely new levels as well! This is your chance to finally unlock Santa Henk and Henkdolph again!

Merry christmas to you all, and a happy new year!

Cheers from the RageSquid team.

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]New winter environment, including the possibility to unlock santa henk & henkdolph
[*]Improved controller support! We now have a different input system which should support basically any controller (instead of just the xbox360 controller). Please let us know if you still have any trouble with a contoller.
[*]Potential performance increases! There have been some changes to the way level geometry is loaded, which could have very positive impact on in-game performance. We’ll see how this functions over the next days and decide if we should keep it.
[/list]

[b]Community highlights:[/b]
Congratulations to pichusuperlover and |lDgAl|HaXeRMaN for winning the Action Henk Team Tournament! We had a great time seeing the community come together during this awesome event! Thank you |lDgAl| badBlackShark for organising this tournament! Hope to see everyone participating next time as well!

notes.title: Daily challenge update and free week!
notes.content:
Hey all!

Hope the wait wasn't too long for everyoneːsteamhappyː It’s time we bring a new feature into the game! So if you’re interested, check out this video right here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DEQJ4ra0oO8

Also, this week you can try Action Henk for free on Steam, so tell all your friends to check it out! And let's welcome everybody who is new to the game into this wonderful community of awesome people! To everyone who got here from the free week to check this announcement, good day to you, and thanks for checking out the game! <3

notes.title: Spooky times with a new update!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/HHsJyIt.jpg[/img]

Hey Everyone!

Do you guys dare to unlock HallowHenk and Wicked Betsy? Two new skins available to unlock during Halloween only, time to gotta ghost fast! 

While working hard on the console version together with Curve Digital, we also managed to build an update for this Halloween. We’ve been working together with the community to fix some issues related to the leaderboards, and added some extra features as well! A big thank you to all the lovely people that helped us and put so much effort into making Action Henk a better game. Always amazed by everyone’s dedication!    

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]HallowHenk and Wicked Betsy can be unlocked for the next two weeks by completing all Halloween levels (for henk) or completing all Night levels (for betsy). (Challenge & bonus levels excluded)
[*]The global overall leaderboard now fetches your steam times to calculate a final score rather than using your (sometimes broken) local bests. Please note it can take a good minute after starting up for your new score to be calculated. After that any new highscore should instantly update your global overall score.
[*]While selecting levels for multiplayer there is also a randomize button which selects a random set of levels.
[*]Way of the Ninja geometry added to fix the camera issues in the beginning
[*]Developer console disabled. All skins obtained through the ‘unlock all’ command which are not unlockable in the game will be disabled again.
[*]Anti-Macro system. We’ve been looking into this and decided the best solution is to limit the player jump input to 10 jumps per second (one jump every 0.1 seconds). Every jump press above this speed will be ignored. This way we can still have the interesting trick of tapping multiple jumps to gain speed, while still keeping it at a human maximum. What this also means is that over the course of the next weeks we will start cleaning up some of the leaderboards that now have broken replays. Please note that as we are doing this we will keep track of everything we had to delete, so everyone can see if they need to re-do certain levels.
[*]Fixed a bug where the special thanks credits would show up in regular levels.
[*]Fixed a bug where pressing soft-reset (enter) in multiplayer would have you jump all the way to the start on other clients.
[*]World Champion skin added for our AHWC winner Activy!
[/list]

[b]Experimental changes:[/b]
Based on community feedback we have added some experimental features. These features are still rough around the edges and have a good chance of breaking at certain points. By keeping it to basic functionality rather than full polished goodness we were able to easily implement these features without having to spend weeks on making it work perfectly in every situation.
[list]
[*]You can now watch your [i]own[/i] replays for bonus & challenge levels. Replays of other people are still inaccessible.
[*]Multiplayer spectator mode is available for everyone! This feature was originally built for the Action Henk World Championships, but there were many requests to keep it in. You can use it by holding the left-shift key and pressing 1-9. The camera will then focus different players in your multiplayer match
[*]Replay playback options! While watching a replay you can press control + left arrow or right arrow to jump back or forward in time. This feature is a little jumpy, but it provides a decent way to watch just a small portion of a replay without having to wait for it to loop completely.
[/list]

[b]Community Highlights:[/b]
The first Action Henk World Championships have definitely been a success! Congratulations Activy for getting 1st place! Also good job Seraphimo27 and Magg the Sloth for getting respectively 2nd and 3rd! If you’re curious check out the [url=http://actionhenk.com/ahwc_brackets.png]tournament brackets[/url]. Be sure to also check out [url=https://www.youtube.com/user/ThePersuitOfInfinity/videos]Goku’s Youtube channel[/url] if you want to relive some of the action.
Thanks everyone for being involved and there is definitely more to come!

notes.title: Action Henk's first post-launch update is now live!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/SQLMtdg.jpg[/img]

Hey Everyone!

It’s been 2 weeks since launch now, and we have been taking a bit of time off to recover from the hectic crunch time. However, we have already been sitting down and prepared a small update fixing some problems based on the initial feedback and bug reports we have been getting. Be sure to let us know if you still run into any issues, we are eager to fix any problems that arise!

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]You can now see what you did to earn a particular skin in the character selection screen.
[*]Multiplayer chat window got an overhaul.
[*]We disabled 3 achievements because they were handed out to some players without the criteria of the achievements being met. We’re looking into it.
[*]Fixed a bug where the game would sometimes crash when switching levels in multiplayer.
[*]Fixed a bug where the player sometimes couldn’t add Workshop levels to a multiplayer server level rotation.
[/list]

[b]Community Highlights:[/b]
If you have a spare 2858 minutes, check out [url=http://www.twitch.tv/manvsgame/v/5037599]MANvsGAME’s 48-hour stream![/url]
To honor MAN’s dedication we implemented an achievement in his name, all you have to do to unlock it is complete every campaign level (excluding city & bonus levels) in one session. This will also reward you with a MANvsGAME themed skin for Henk. Good luck! 

[b]Coming up:[/b]
There’s still a couple of things we would like to fix in the near future, like for example uploading personal bests in multiplayer matches that many people have been asking for. We also want to take a closer look at the performance issues some people have been getting on the Mac version. These are just a couple of the things we still want to look into, so don’t hesitate to let us know if you run into any bugs or issues, we will keep improving the game!

notes.title: Action Henk is Out Now!
notes.content:
IT'S HERE! Action Henk 1.0 is now live!

Be sure to check out our launch trailer:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OBpeyD43nkg
We didn't want the final update to be just 'removing the Early Access label', so we really tried our best to make the full game stand out. We've added outdoor environments, improved online multiplayer, storyline videos, Twitch chat integration, new characters, new skins and a whole bunch more!

Developing this has been an amazing rollercoaster ride, and we hope you all love the end result as much as we are proud of it! MASSIVE THANKS to everyone who supported us during Early Access :D :D

ENJOY!

- The RageSquid Team

notes.title: A small update from the RageSquid team!
notes.content:
[img]http://ragesquid.com/henk/water.png[/img]

Hey guys!
We've been quiet for a while but I'm here to give you a small update on what we've been up to.
The past couple of weeks have been busy, some of us went to the USA to visit GDC in San Francisco and we had a little Action Henk stand at SXSW in Austin, we had a ton of fun over there and we met a lot of amazing players and other developers. 

Meanwhile back home we moved offices again, we're in a big new building (still in Utrecht) with lots of other game studios, it's a great environment to be in. 

Work on Henk hasn't been standing still, though. A lot of content has been finished up and it's looking great. Right now we're tying up all loose ends and the end of development is finally in sight. We're looking to release the game somewhere in the next month or two and I can promise that the final version of the game will definitely be a significant step up from the last Early Access version you guys are playing right now. 

I really can't wait to reveal to you all the final version (and I'm probably speaking for the entire team here). Working on it has been amazing and I'd like to thank you all for the support and sticking with us <3

Now, time to get back to work. We'll keep you up to date when we've picked a launch date!

-Lex

notes.title: Early Access v9 - Challenge Your Friends and Bonus Levels!
notes.content:
Early Access v9 - Challenge your friends!
[img]http://i.imgur.com/oitiq8p.jpg[/img]

[b]It’s update time again! We’re really getting close to the finish line, meaning that this will be the final update before we go for the full-blown release. It’s been a great run, and we’d really like to thank all of you for being a part of the process so far.[/b]

This last Early Access update is not a small one! We revamped a big part of the interface, and you can now challenge your friends after you’ve beaten them on the leaderboards. If you’re looking for a new kind of single-player challenge, be sure to check out the new bonus levels!

We don’t have a final release date planned yet, but we’re aiming to go gold in about a month or two. If you want be kept up to date, our [url=https://www.facebook.com/RageSquid]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/ragesquid]Twitter[/url] will have more info as we get closer to launch!

Enjoy!

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Challenge your friends! Whenever you beat one of your friends’ highscores, you have the option to challenge them to take on your times. You will see who challenged you when you open the game, but you also have the option to receive the messages directly in Steam!
[*]Interface Overhaul (work-in-progress). As we’re gearing up towards launch, we’re in the middle of a big overhaul for the interface. Most of it is fully functional, but you might run into some parts that are still under construction, they will be fixed soon! ;)
[*]Bonus levels. After getting gold on all the levels in a batch, you’ll unlock the bonus level. These levels are about collecting all the coins as fast as possible, and if your time is fast enough you’ll unlock a new skin![/list]

[b]New Levels:[/b]
[list]
[*]Bonus1-5. These levels are pretty hard!
[/list]

[b]Characters/Skins:[/b]
[list]
[*]Bonus 1: Swan Henk. (most of you have this skin unlocked already, but this is the new way of unlocking it)
[*]Bonus 2: Corporate Betsy.
[*]Bonus 3: Gabber Betsy. (same story here, again, this is the new way of unlocking her)
[*]Bonus 4: IT Neil.
[*]Bonus 5: Zombie Neil.
[/list]

[b]Misc:[/b]
[list]
[*]We fixed a whoooole bunch of small things, but whenever your run into something that’s broken be sure to let us know in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/285820/discussions/0/620700960874964491/]Bugs & Feedback[/url] thread on the forums! As we’re getting ready for the full release we really want to squash all of the remaining bugs!
[/list]

[b]Community highlights:[/b]
A few weeks ago we held a big Christmas marathon event and we’d like to thank all of you for running with us! The distance walked by all players during the marathon was added up and in the end we walked ~575 kilometers! Pretty amazing when you realize that Henk’s height is about 5 centimeters. Every set amount of kilometers a reward was unlocked, you can still check them all out [url=http://actionhenk.com/marathon/]here.[/url]

[*]Interface Overhaul (work-in-progress). As we’re gearing up towards launch, we’re in the middle of a big overhaul for the interface. Most of it is fully functional, but you might run into some parts that are still under construction, they will be fixed soon! ;)
[*]Bonus levels. After getting gold on all the levels in a batch, you’ll unlock the bonus level. These levels are about collecting all the coins as fast as possible, and if your time is fast enough you’ll unlock a new skin![/list]

[b]New Levels:[/b]
[list]
[*]Bonus1-5. These levels are pretty hard!
[/list]

[b]Characters/Skins:[/b]
[list]
[*]Bonus 1: Swan Henk. (most of you have this skin unlocked already, but this is the new way of unlocking it)
[*]Bonus 2: Corporate Betsy.
[*]Bonus 3: Gabber Betsy. (same story here, again, this is the new way of unlocking her)
[*]Bonus 4: IT Neil.
[*]Bonus 5: Zombie Neil.
[/list]

[b]Misc:[/b]
[list]
[*]We fixed a whoooole bunch of small things, but whenever your run into something that’s broken be sure to let us know in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/285820/discussions/0/620700960874964491/]Bugs & Feedback[/url] thread on the forums! As we’re getting ready for the full release we really want to squash all of the remaining bugs!
[/list]

[b]Community highlights:[/b]
A few weeks ago we held a big Christmas marathon event and we’d like to thank all of you for running with us! The distance walked by all players during the marathon was added up and in the end we walked ~575 kilometers! Pretty amazing when you realize that Henk’s height is about 5 centimeters. Every set amount of kilometers a reward was unlocked, you can still check them all out [url=http://actionhenk.com/marathon/]here.[/url]

notes.title: Early Access v8 - Level Editor and Disco Fever!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.ragesquid.com/press/action_henk/images/neil.png[/img]

Hello everybody! This patch we’re going to introduce another visual style. It’s another room in the dark but instead of going for a spooky vibe, we went for something a little more… funky. We’ve moved some of the existing levels to this new disco environment and made a few new levels, too. The final level in the disco-themed batch will introduce Henk’s sensei, Neil. Beat him to unlock him as a playable character!

The level editor is here! Players can now create, share and play community levels. Look for cool creations or share your own through the integrated Steam Workshop. Keep in mind that as with all features, it’s in an early access state. The interface in particular isn’t finished and all editor functionality might break at some point. We’d appreciate it if you could let us know when something breaks so we can fix it! We’ll also keep adding features over time.

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Level editor.
[*]Steam Workshop support for levels.
[/list]
[b]Levels:[/b]
New levels
[list]
[*]Party Hardy (Easy).
[*]Neil’s Challenge (Easy, Challenge level). 
[*]Boxing Betsy’s Challenge (Easy, Challenge level).
[*]Betsy’s Hook Challenge (Medium, Challenge level).
[/list]
Other level changes/fixes
[list]
[*]Tornado, Spaghetti, Boing and Easy Peasy moved to the disco environment.
[*]Kentony’s Challenge 1 now unlocks Kentony if you can beat him.
[*]The following levels have been altered in such a way that it invalidated all replays so they have their leaderboards reset: Hot Feet, Tornado, Spaghetti, Boing, Easy Peasy and Halfway Hook.
[/list]
[b]Audio:[/b]
[list]
[*]New song: Betsy’s theme 8 bit version.
[*]New song: Disco theme.
[*]New song: Level editor theme.
[/list]
[b]Characters/Skins:[/b]
[list]
[*]Neil.
[*]Kentony.
[*]Boxing Betsy.
[*]Warrior Betsy.
[/list]
[b]Misc:[/b]
[list]
[*]Level editor achievement awarded when a level is uploaded.
[*]New camera shots when the player is selecting a ghost to race against.
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Lighting in Halloween environment adjusted.
[*]Ingame camera movement smoother. (There were people who thought they didn’t have 60 fps while fps meters stated they did, this should fix it.)
[*]Physics bug fixed where the character would suddenly release from or stick to the track when it was not supposed to.
[/list]

[b]Community:[/b]
For the past 2 weeks we’ve tested the level editor with a small group of people. I’d like to thank every one of them for their feedback and support, we needed it. ;)
Thanks in particular go out to steam users: Qwertzoi, Minirop, Tomus, Greenlizard307, Jwaaap, Dom, EnButtetSkude, Sos Sosowski, ConnorUllmann and ConradZimmerman.

Minirop is working on a [url=https://twitter.com/minirop/status/539080445917679616/photo/1]tool[/url] which can do an analysis of your checkpoint times and give you an estimate of what your best time could be. Pretty amazing to see!

notes.title: Early Access v7 - Halloween Update is live!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.ragesquid.com/press/action_henk/images/halloween_02.png[/img]

It’s Halloween, time for treats! We’re proud to introduce a new visual style. Next to the ‘kids room’ environment that we’re all familiar with, we now present to you a brand new spooky Halloween themed version of the room! Feast your eyes on all of the new visuals in the Halloween levels! 

[b]Levels:[/b]
There’s a whole new batch of levels, the Halloween batch. Six levels in the new visual style!
[list]
[*]New: Gotta Ghost Fast (Medium).
[*]New: Wicked Waves (Medium). 
[*]New: Cursed Curves (Medium).
[*]New: Deadly Drops (Medium).
[*]New: Tricks & Treats (Medium).
[*]New: Kentony Challenge 1 (Medium, Challenge level).
[/list]
Other level changes/fixes
[list]
[*]New: Getting Hooked (Easy, Hook level).
[*]The ending of Betsy’s Challenge is changed to be a bit easier.
[*]Fixed a bug in Tornado where you could skip a part of the level and mess up the physics.
[*]Renamed: First Steps is now called Back 2 Back.
[*]Renamed: Hook Shot is now called Smooth Swinging.
[/list]
[b]Audio:[/b]
[list]
[*]New song: Halloween theme.
[*]All tracks remastered.
[*]Music played is now related to level batches instead of the current character.
[/list]
[b]Characters/Skins:[/b]
[list]
[*]Two new Halloween themed skins. Hallowhenk and Wicked Betsy.
[/list]
[b]Misc:[/b]
[list]
[*]Floor is lava received another facelift.
[*]We’ve begun implementing Steam Achievements! For now we have two. One for the Betsy challenge and one for the new challenge in the Halloween level batch.
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where you could launch your character if you would use the grappling hook in a corner. (We also removed all high-scores that used this trick).
[*]Fixed a multiplayer bug where there would be no new level selected after one is finished.
[/list]


[b]Community highlights:[/b]
Our favorite video this month came from Kevin Regamey, who managed to [url=http://www.twitch.tv/otdq/c/5262539]completely break the game[/url] in several different ways! Unfortunately for you, these bugs have been fixed now ;)

notes.title: Early Access v6 is live!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/Am01FOn.jpg[/img]

The multiplayer tryouts were a great success! We’ve gathered all the user & technical feedback that we need, and for now the servers will be offline again for a while.

In this update we’d like to welcome our new level design intern, Keano. The new levels in this update are the fruits of his hard work, let us know what you think of them!

During the past weeks we’ve been busy visiting several events: Fantastic Arcade in Austin (Texas, USA), Indigo in Utrecht (NL) and EGX in London (UK). Thanks to everyone who dropped by and said hi!

[b]Levels:[/b]
[list]
[*]New: Backside Basics (Beginner).
[*]New: Easy Peasy (Easy).
[*]New: Bumper Jumper (Medium).
[*]New: Pipe ‘n Slide (Medium).
[*]New: The Zigzag (Hard).
[*]The way the levels are grouped has been restructured.
[/list]
[b]Interface:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added an Action Henk title screen. If you stay in this screen for a while, the game will start showing replays for random levels.
[*]You can erase your medals, replays and progress in the Settings -> Game menu. (This will wipe the medals from your account, not just the local machine.)
[*]The medal count is now visualized in the top right corner of the GUI screens where it’s relevant.
[/list]
[b]Misc:[/b]
[list]
[*]Audio levels of all categories have been tweaked for a more normalized experience.
[*]The floor is lava is in the middle of a facelift. A first version of the new lava is included.
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where the character would sometimes let go of the track if you went up a ramp really fast.
[/list]
[b]Community highlights[/b]
Two weeks ago we were surprised by an Action Henk video by YOGSCAST’s Martyn (InTheLittleWood). He had an amazing time, so much that he made 3 more videos shortly after the first, where he covers every single level. All of them are great to watch. If you have a few spare minutes, find them  [url=https://www.youtube.com/user/inthelittlewood/videos]here[/url] ;).

[b]Next Update[/b]
We’ve got something special planned for Halloween, make sure to tune in on our [url=https://www.facebook.com/RageSquid]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/ragesquid]Twitter[/url] to be kept up to date!

notes.title: Early Access v5 (Multiplayer try-outs!) is live!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/FxAFhi5.jpg[/img]

Two weeks ago we set out for a challenge, which was to implement online multiplayer into Action Henk before the next update. After two very hectic weeks, we’re proud to announce that we managed to do it. Everyone can now try out the first version of Action Henk’s multiplayer!

Because this is still an early version, the servers will only be online every [b]Thursday and Saturday from 18:00 till 02:00 CET (11am-7pm PDT)[/b]. This is to make sure that we can oversee the playtests, and keep a close eye to make sure everything functions properly. There is a possibility that we will be doing extra playtests, so make sure you join the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/285820]Official Steam group[/url] to be kept up to date on any changes!

Another important announcement we need to make is that the next update will not be in two weeks. This is because we have found out that pushing out an update every two weeks doesn't give us the time to polish new features as much as we would like to. Because of all this, we will be aiming to release the next update at the end of September. This will allow us to stay focused for longer, and give you more, higher quality content at once! The bi-weekly updates basically put us in a constant state of crunch time, which our bodies can only cope with for so long. ;) 

As usual, we will keep everyone up to date on our [url=https://www.facebook.com/RageSquid]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/ragesquid]Twitter[/url]. Be sure to like/follow us there if you want to be in on some sneak peeks!

We hope you enjoy the first multiplayer version, and stay tuned for more cool multiplayer stuff we have planned!

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]First version of multiplayer! A level is played for a couple of minutes, and within this time you can play and retry as often as you like, its about who can set the best score during this time. If you win you get points, and the more players you beat, the more points you get. These global multiplayer points will be showcased on a global multiplayer leaderboard.
[/list]

[b]Community highlights[/b]
One of Action Henk’s best players ‘Qwertzoi’ has been making some super helpful videos where he [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCCRQ3JO9Q1jxKgzaCd4GPFw/videos]explains how to do all tracks in-depth[/url]. So if you’re struggling to get those notorious rainbow medals, be sure to to listen to his advice.

notes.title: Early Access v4 is live!
notes.content:
[img=http://i.imgur.com/KlwrMiy.jpg]

The past two weeks most of us were attending the Game Developers Conference and Gamescom in Cologne (Germany) to showcase the game to people from all over the world. 
Nonetheless we still managed to get a couple of cool things in this update. We’ve got 64-bit Linux support, more skin-specific particles and a very, very long level. 
We’re also happy to announce that next week we will be showcasing Action Henk at PAX Prime at the Indie MEGABOOTH! So if you’re around, make sure to drop by and chat with us!

[b]New Platforms:[/b]
[list]
[*]Linux 64-bit support! Leaderboards and replays now work on Linux 64-bit.
[/list]

[b]New Levels:[/b]
[list]
[*]Marathon (Medium). This level is loooong!
[/list]

[b]Interface:[/b]
[list]
[*]People who have identical times now also have identical ranks. 
[*]Level select list improved.
[/list]

[b]Misc:[/b]
[list]
[*]Most of the character skins have received death particles and/or sounds for when they fall in the lava. Most skins also have their particles updated to make them stand out from each other even more. Most notably: Swan Henk, Blue Blaze Henk and Boxing Betsy.
[*]We’ve had problems with the Steamworks plugin we use so we’ve replaced the whole thing altogether, this should reduce the number of random crashes some people had. 
[*]When you get to the character select it starts at the most recently played character/skin combination.
[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b][list]
[*]The anti-aliasing menu option now works correctly.
[*]The alternative Henk theme now plays correctly.
[/list]

[b]Community highlights[/b]
Community member Assault brought [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gYr64eQDndk]this video[/url] to our attention, it’s an amazing attempt at the world record on “The Drop”, he absolutely nails it! This morning we also laughed at [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p0dtRGQqGG0]Tengu Drop’s[/url] new video. He basically tries every hard level there is, and eventually gives up because they are way too hard for him :D

[b]Next Update[/b]
We’ll be customizing the character skins more with unique sound effects and more unique particles per skin. We’re also working on something big but that’ll have to wait until next update ;)

That’s it again, as always we’ll be on the forums and the next update will be ready for you in two weeks, we can’t wait for that one!

The RageSquid team.

[*]Most of the character skins have received death particles and/or sounds for when they fall in the lava. Most skins also have their particles updated to make them stand out from each other even more. Most notably: Swan Henk, Blue Blaze Henk and Boxing Betsy.
[*]We’ve had problems with the Steamworks plugin we use so we’ve replaced the whole thing altogether, this should reduce the number of random crashes some people had. 
[*]When you get to the character select it starts at the most recently played character/skin combination.
[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b][list]
[*]The anti-aliasing menu option now works correctly.
[*]The alternative Henk theme now plays correctly.
[/list]

[b]Community highlights[/b]
Community member Assault brought [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gYr64eQDndk]this video[/url] to our attention, it’s an amazing attempt at the world record on “The Drop”, he absolutely nails it! This morning we also laughed at [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p0dtRGQqGG0]Tengu Drop’s[/url] new video. He basically tries every hard level there is, and eventually gives up because they are way too hard for him :D

[b]Next Update[/b]
We’ll be customizing the character skins more with unique sound effects and more unique particles per skin. We’re also working on something big but that’ll have to wait until next update ;)

That’s it again, as always we’ll be on the forums and the next update will be ready for you in two weeks, we can’t wait for that one!

The RageSquid team.

notes.title: Early Access v3 is live!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/P1OV518.jpg[/img]

For this update we focused on requests we found on the community forums. We've added cloud syncing for medals, more detailed quality settings and a nice 25% increase in performance! To top it off there are 3 new levels, including some crazy stuff with the jump pad blocks. Enjoy!

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Medals cloud syncing. Your medals now carry over if you play on a different computer with your Steam account!
[*]Anti Aliasing, VSync,Texture Quality and Anisotropic Filtering settings added to the graphical options menu. 
[/list]
[b]New Levels:[/b]
[list]
[*]Multipath (Easy)
[*]Boing! (Easy/Medium)
[*]Pinball (Hard)
[/list]
[b]Interface:[/b]
[list]
[*]The level select now shows you which of the levels are new.
[*]Graphical options menu received a small rework.
[*]The pre game interface now tells you when it’s busy downloading a replay file.
[/list]
[b]Misc:[/b]
[list]
[*]Characters now rotate in character select. Look at Henk's glorious behind!
[*]Graphical performance improved by roughly 25%, noticeable in particular on lower end machines.
[*]We’re experimenting with unique particles per skin. Different trails have been added to each skin, there’s more to come!
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Personal best replays are no longer cleared when an update happens!
[*]Personal best replays are no longer local but are now fetched from the Steam leaderboards. You can now be sure that the personal best replay matches your best time on the leaderboards.
[*]The camera doesn't freeze up anymore when you go through character select too fast.
[*]The unlock criteria in the skin selection screen now match the actual unlock criteria.
[*]The animations will now reset properly when hitting the reset button.
[/list]
[b]Community highlights[/b]
We’re still watching all of the Let’s Play videos we come across and are loving every one of them. We’d specifically like to mention this one by [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lhG1gGA-k4w ]Kakujo[/url] where he talks us through the previous update. It’s awesome to see all the videos pop up, keep ‘em coming! :D

[b]Next Update[/b]
The next two weeks most of us will be in Cologne, Germany. We’re going to visit a series of events: Evoke, GDC Europe and Gamescom. This means that next update will probably be a bit smaller. In case you happen to be at Gamescom, make sure to drop by our stand at the Holland Pavilion in Hall 4.2. Also, if you’re in a competitive mood you can join the Action Henk tournament we’re hosting at the Unity booth on Wednesday!

That’s it for now, we’ll be on the forums and we’ll bring you the next update in two weeks!

The RageSquid team.

notes.title: Early Access v2 is live!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/d9ubXS0.jpg[/img]

It’s been 2 weeks since the Early Access launch, and the first update is here! We’ve added 7 brand new levels, integrated a lot of user interface feedback, and you can now race against the incredibly challenging Rainbow Medals!

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Rainbow medals! Extreme difficulty for the die-hard players.
[/list]
[b]New Levels:[/b]
[list]
[*]The Drop (hook, easy)
[*]Close Call (hook, medium)
[*]Throwback (hook, medium)
[*]Pro Skater (easy)
[*]Leap of Faith (medium)
[*]Quick Tricks (medium)
[*]The Big Climb (hard)
[/list]
The game now has 25 levels in total, increasing the amount by almost 40%!

[b]Interface:[/b]
[list]
[*]You can now switch ghosts from the post game screen.
Leaderboards per level can be accessed in the level select screen.
[*]Ingame tutorial during the first three levels of the first batch and the first three levels of the grappling hook batch.
[*]Added the option to randomize the ingame music in the audio settings menu.
[*]Added the option to hide the ingame tutorial in the game settings menu.
[/list]
[b]Controls:[/b]
[list]
[*]‘R’ on keyboard now acts as a reset button ingame. 
[*]Added xbox360 controller D-pad support ingame.
[/list]
[b]Misc:[/b]
[list]
[*]New unlockable Betsy skin when you unlock 3 Rainbow medals.
[*]WIP_21 is now known as Full Stop
[*]WIP_19 is now known as The Wall
[*]WIP_9 is now known as Back & Forth
[*]WIP_20 is now known as Spaghetti
[*]Because of significant changes, leaderboards for  Back & Forth, Full Stop and The Wall have been reset.
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Slide sound volume now in relation to the sfx volume slider in the audio settings.
[*]Postgame repeating audio bug fixed.
[*][LINUX] Fixed a bug where some linux machines couldn’t load medal replays.
[*]Fixed the loud noise when switching scenes.
[/list]

[b]Thank you![/b]
We’d like to thank everyone who has bought and is playing Action Henk at such an early stage! Your support is great, and really encourages us to make Action Henk the best game we can! We also want to thank everyone who has been commenting in the forums, your feedback and bug reports are speeding up our development process greatly. Thanks!


[b]Community highlights[/b]
We absolutely loved the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=283440162]fan art[/url] made by our friends from Wooden Plank Studios. We’ve also been seeing a huge amount of youtube let’s plays! Here’s [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7pCJZrqMyrc]one of our favorites[/url] by Kakujo. There’s been coverage in a lot of different languages, including [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VF-ruuV2-FI ]Italian[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kBFrdMg_O_8 ]French[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1Q_sCc2yrI8 ]Russian[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ygfoB8MtVhE ]German[/url] and of course in [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iojLEOCUJL0 ]Dutch[/url] :D

That’s all, have fun!

The RageSquid team.
